newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel holds, low sulphur slips back.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel holds, low sulphur slips back.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices ignored the fall in Brent futures to hold steady on Wednesday but low sulphur continued to weaken, traders said.

High sulphur barges were supported early by bunker demand before business went quiet. Deals were done at $82.50 for prompt material and at $83 fob ARA for later delivery, on a par with Tuesday's business.
"Barges were a bit bubbly and then went dead," said one trader, "and again (high sulphur) fuel didn't fellow Brent down."

Low sulphur was again depressed by good supply and demand levels dictated by the one big Italian buyer. Weaker futures on the back of bearish stock data and poor straight-run values overhanging the cracked market were also factors.
Little business was seen done though a trader was heard to have picked up a packet from a U.S. company to cover a short requirement into Italy. The deal was heard done at a floating price.
Low sulphur was notionally priced at $86/$87 fob in northern Europe, the level indicated by weakening swaps numbers for May, traders said. - London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
